new.doc: `SmEdgeDefinition::Split` gives the new upper definition its own copies of the 3D and UV curves and trims both definitions' curves to their intervals before `AddEdgeDefinition` hangs the new one on the upper proto edge.

With `simple_coincidence_crossing_is_point`, `SimpleCoincidenceChecker` decides on which side of this curve the other lies from the end pairs' separation across this curve (its tangent's component removed).

`SmTopologyIntersector::IntersectInsertRelate` keeps the proto topology's capture distance below half the smallest distance between two vertices of either operand (never below the intersection tolerance), so that no proto vertex captures two distinct vertices of one operand: two points d apart are never both closer than d / 2 to a third.

`SmEdge::RadialSectorClassify`, when stepping off the edge leaves a face before the classification is unique, reads a coincident classify face's side against the face it coincides with: the sector edge use's face (`CoincidentSector` or its mate) or the radial partner's (`CoincidentRadial` or its mate), as the coincidence test of the same loop does (with the sector face's normal, and with the classify face's normal from its projected binormal).
